summary: Iter165 — FUUSIC New Look V2 Home realignment (Social-first ecosystem) tested across shared backend + web + mobile. All 10 backend tests PASS (test_iter165_fuusic_home.py). Backend proof: GET /api/shell/home returns new fields fuusic_world (Social first & featured), together_actions (4 items), pillar_order (default ['social','listen','live','shop','play','dining','earn','explore']), home_config (7 sections with visible+title incl 'together'='Do Something Together'), AND legacy fields (for_you, live_now, native_offer, listening_reward, dining, is_premium, top_genre). Admin GET/PUT /api/admin/home-config gated (401 anon / non-admin, 200 admin); PUT correctly validates pillar_order (drops unknown 'bogus_key', dedupes, appends missing pillars so set is always complete) and reflects immediately in /api/shell/home. GET /api/social/home returns happening_now{live_experiences,friends_listening,friends_online}, friends_now[], suggested_rooms[], counts{friends,friend_requests}, do_together[]. POST /api/shell/home-events accepts all 12 new events (home_fuusic_world_view, home_pillar_click, home_social_click, home_listen_click, home_live_click, home_shop_click, home_play_click, home_dining_click, home_earn_click, home_explore_click, home_together_action_click, home_whats_happening_click) → {ok:true}; unknown event → {ok:false}. Defaults restored on teardown (pillar_order social-first, together visible=true title='Do Something Together'). WEB logged-in Home (demo user, NLV2 default): top sequence VERIFIED — nlv2-hero (y=92) → nlv2-fuusic-world (584) → nlv2-whats-happening (1191) → nlv2-continue (1381) → nlv2-foryou (1636) → nlv2-live (1962) → nlv2-together (2288). Social pillar rendered wider/featured; nlv2-pillar-social click routes to /social. What's Happening honest empty state ('Discover Social') visible via nlv2-happening-empty (no fabricated counts). AppShellV2 top nav order: Home, Social, Listen, Shop, Play (nlv2-nav-social present, Social BEFORE Listen). Right rail copy '6 skips per rolling hour' PRESENT; phrase 'unlimited skips' ABSENT. WEB public landing (anon): nav order Social first (public-nav-logo, public-nav-social, public-nav-listen, public-nav-shop, public-nav-play, public-nav-dining, public-nav-for-business), broadened hero 'Everything you love, together.' present, 'Everything on FUUSIC' ecosystem grid (public-ecosystem y=684) BEFORE Shop (4075) and Play (4366); public-pillar-social featured; Social preview (public-social y=3785) ABOVE Shop/Play. WEB /admin/home-config renders full Pillar Order UI (Social FEATURED first) + Sections visibility/title toggles + Reload/Save buttons. MOBILE Home (/(tabs)/home.tsx via Expo web preview 390x844, demo login): greeting 'Hi, Demo — everything you love, together.' present; FUUSIC World horizontal pill rail with Social first & featured (home-pillar-social x=16 wider tile visible) then Listen(100)/Live(184)/Shop(268)/Play(352)/Dining/Earn; home-social-discover card ('Do things together / Listen together, join clubs & share Moments') shown as empty state; tapping home-pillar-social navigates to /social; existing sections (Start My Radio, For You, Live right now) still render. No red screen, no bundler crash.

issues: Mobile FUUSIC World rail has NO section heading ('Your FUUSIC World') above the horizontal pills — web shows the title, mobile omits it. Parity gap, cosmetic. All pill testIDs render + routing works.

parity_issues.issue: Web NLV2 shows 'Your FUUSIC World' + subtitle above the pillar grid; mobile omits the section heading entirely and jumps straight into the pill rail.
parity_issues.expected: Both surfaces show a matching 'Your FUUSIC World' label to anchor the section for users.
parity_issues.actual: Mobile shows no label; heading only exists on web.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add a 'Your FUUSIC World' section heading above the mobile home pill rail to match web NLV2 parity.
critical_code_review_comments: core/home_config._valid_order correctly drops unknown pillars, dedupes, and appends missing pillars — verified via PUT with 'bogus_key' + partial order.

shell/home flattens home_config sections directly onto home_config (each entry {visible,title}) while admin/home-config nests them under 'sections'. Two different shapes for what is semantically the same object — consider unifying to always return {pillar_order, sections:{...}} so downstream clients don't have to branch. Not a bug, just consistency.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows verified; 1 minor parity gap: mobile missing FUUSIC World heading)
